name: Sequences
description: Represents a collection of Sequence objects. Use a Sequence object to add, find, modify, and clone animation effects.
example:
Sub AddNewSequence()

    Dim shp1 As Shape
    Dim shp2 As Shape
    Dim interEffect As Effect

    Set shp1 = ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes.AddShape _
        (Type:=msoShape32pointStar, Left:=100, _
        Top:=100, Width:=200, Height:=200)

    Set shp2 = ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes.AddShape _
        (Type:=msoShapeBevel, Left:=400, _
        Top:=200, Width:=150, Height:=100)

    With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).TimeLine.InteractiveSequences.Add(1)
        Set interEffect = .AddEffect(shp2, msoAnimEffectBlinds, _
            trigger:=msoAnimTriggerOnShapeClick)
        interEffect.Shape = shp1
    End With

End Sub

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single Sequence object from the specified Sequences collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single Sequence object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Returns a Sequence object that represents a new sequence.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The position of the sequence in relation to other sequences. The default value is -1, which means that if you omit the Index parameter, the new sequence is added to the end of the existing sequences.
